gaps_from_08f4.title: Malformed run state accepted silently
gaps_from_08f4.description: A run.json missing required fields (goal, mode) is not rejected by execute_run. It returns status='completed' with no error.

gaps_from_08f4.title: Auto write-intent escalation not reflected in run state
gaps_from_08f4.description: governance.mode_requires_escalation correctly detects auto+write intent, but LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 keeps mode_effective=auto after create_run/execute_run.

gaps_from_08f4.title: No internal timeout/circuit-breaker for graph invocation
gaps_from_08f4.description: execute_run invokes the graph without an internal timeout. A stalled node causes the call to hang until the external client times out or the process is killed.

gaps_from_08f4.title: Test-harness artifact for missing token header
gaps_from_08f4.description: require_strict_operator_access is an async FastAPI dependency. Direct synchronous invocation returns a coroutine instead of raising 401/403. Real FastAPI awaits it correctly.

recommended_next_action: Repair safety gaps in a new scoped source patch front. No amend. No force push. Native remains default. Start with BUG-08F4-03 (timeout/circuit-breaker), then BUG-08F4-01 and BUG-08F4-02.
